Mass Effect Shield System v13.0.0

First public release. Requires Foundry VTT v13 and PF2e system v7.0.0+.

Features

  • Kinetic Shields — Equipment item that sets actor Temp HP on pickup. Shields recharge each turn in combat; depleted shields require the actor to Take Cover before recharging begins.
  • Shield HP Mods (Tier 1–4) — Equipment mods that increase shield capacity by +10/+20/+40/+70 HP.
  • Shield Regen Mods (Tier 1–4) — Equipment mods that multiply shield regen rate by ×1.5/×2.0/×2.5/×3.0.
  • Biotic Barrier — Effect item with HP calculated from actor level (5 × ⌊level ÷ 2⌋, minimum 5). Absorbs damage before shields and HP. Displayed via PF2e badge counter on the effect icon.
  • Activate Biotic Barrier — Feat (PC) and Action (NPC) items that apply the Biotic Barrier effect via PF2e's selfEffect system.
  • Electricity weakness — Shock/electricity damage deals double damage to shields.
  • Shield collapse — A single hit exceeding half shield max collapses the shield instantly; excess damage overflows to HP.
  • Auto-sync — World item templates are automatically recreated when the module version changes.
  • Combined chat messages — Shield and barrier status shown in a single card per turn.
